all_checked.description:
Subject: Urgent Request for Tree Inspection and Maintenance on Neponset Valley Parkway.

Good morning,

I am submitting this report to bring attention to the large trees that are falling and creating a potential safety hazard along Neponset Valley Parkway, particularly between 209 and 239 Neponset Valley Parkway.

I am respectfully requesting that the City send the appropriate tree management team to inspect this area and address the damaged and potentially dangerous trees and properties. I am also requesting that the tree limbs and branches in front of 229 and 239 Neponset Valley Parkway be properly cut back and removed where necessary.

Taking care of these trees and damaged branches now could help prevent future property damage, injuries, or other serious hazards, especially as we approach the winter season when snow, ice, and strong winds can make these conditions worse.

The safety of residents and their homes is very important, and I respectfully ask that this matter be inspected and addressed as soon as possible.

Thank you for your attention to this safety concern and for your assistance in keeping the residents of Neponset Valley Parkway safe. some of this trees are over 40 years old you can see clearly from the pictures. Some areas are properly taken care of while some areas have been neglected. This makes us wonder. Kindly let us do the needful to avoid destruction.

Respectfully,
Concern citizen of the Commonwealth.
